name: cs1.618
purpose: Play an original Verdant-powered browser tactical multiplayer FPS with 5v5 rounds, bots and WebRTC rooms. Its portable identity component admits a handoff only when origin, freshness, signature and explicit consent observations all pass; browser rendering, cryptography and networking remain host responsibilities.

proposition.name: identityAdmission
proposition.text: Every failed identity observation produces deny
proposition.plain: Identity handoff requires all four checks. This is not a proof of the entire game.

inputLabel: origin fresh signature consent (pass or fail)
